site.title: Global Bridge — Egyptian Tech Talent, Global Opportunities
site.description: A hiring platform connecting tech talent in Egypt with international companies and career opportunities.

nav.footerDescription: A hiring platform connecting Egyptian tech talent with international companies and helping companies manage roles and applications.
nav.demoNotice: Some listings may contain demo data marked “Demo.”
nav.footerTrainingNote: Hiring is our core service; training is a separate, optional service.

home.title: Build your next team
home.titleAccent: with Egyptian talent ready to compete globally
home.intro: Hire skilled tech professionals from Egypt, or explore roles at participating international companies and apply for opportunities that fit your career.
home.imageAlt: The Giza pyramids beneath the Cairo sky
home.caption: Local expertise. Opportunities without borders.
home.featuredDescription: Roles posted by companies participating in the platform
home.howIntro: A clear application and review process—with no guarantee of employment.
home.step1Description: Review each role’s requirements, work arrangement, and salary information when provided.
home.step2Description: Submit your application through the platform at no cost. Platform and hiring-company staff may review it.
home.step3Description: The company may contact you about next steps. It makes all interview and hiring decisions.

about.title: About Global Bridge
about.intro: A hiring platform helping tech professionals in Egypt find roles with participating international companies.
about.vision: We help international companies connect with Egyptian tech talent and help candidates discover roles suited to their skills.
about.transparency: Applying to listed roles is free. The hiring company reviews applications and makes interview and hiring decisions; the platform does not guarantee an outcome.
about.identity: We build a practical bridge between technology professionals in Egypt and international companies seeking skilled talent.
about.privacy: Information you submit is used to manage and review your application. Platform administrators and the company hiring for the role may access it and contact you about the application. Submit only the information needed to apply.

jobs.title: Explore technology jobs
jobs.intro: Review each role’s requirements, work arrangement, and salary details when available, then decide whether it fits.
jobs.search: Search by job title or skill (e.g. Node, React, or TypeScript)

companies.title: Build your tech team with talent from Egypt
companies.intro: Post roles, receive candidate applications, and manage reviews in your company workspace.
companies.step1Description: Share the role, requirements, work arrangement, and optional salary details so candidates can assess the opportunity.
companies.step2Description: Review candidate details, skills, and work links. Update application statuses and leave notes for your team.
companies.step3Description: Track applications in your workspace. Your company handles candidate communication, interviews, and hiring decisions.
companies.successDescription: Your request is under review. We’ll contact you at the email provided if there are next steps.
companies.formDescription: Share your company details and hiring needs. This request does not create an account; our team reviews it and follows up.
companies.reviewNotice: Our team reviews requests before setting up a company workspace.
companies.messagePlaceholder: Share any details that will help us understand your hiring needs.
companies.countryPlaceholder: Enter the country where your company is based

training.title: Develop skills for remote tech work
training.intro: Independent programs focused on asynchronous collaboration, documentation, and professional communication with global teams.
training.notice: Training programs are separate and optional. They are not required to apply for jobs and do not guarantee an interview or employment.
training.empty: No training programs are currently published.
